note: Set A correctly binds dimensions to their specific beam details (e.g., D5, C4, A1) and accurately reflects the rectangular opening sizes and offsets found in the drawing. Set B frequently misidentifies beam types (claiming B1 has circular openings when they are rectangular), confuses longitudinal dimensions with widths, and mismatches conditions (attributing Grid 6 values to Grid 5). While Set A has minor attribute naming imprecisions (calling opening height 'depth'), Set B contains fundamental factual errors regarding geometry and beam identity.
